base: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one vertical 9:16 keyframe of a six-keyframe scroll-driven cinematic sequence for VydFlow. Reference image is a character/material/environment reference, not a layout to copy unchanged. Preserve the identical elegant transparent iridescent glass manta ray anatomy, midnight-blue underwater setting, surface ripples at the top, cyan shafts of light, restrained violet glass reflections. Locked camera, consistent focal length, same pool of light and deep black-blue environment across all shots. Main subject must stay wholly within the middle 70% of the portrait, no cropped wing tips. Photorealistic premium glass render, clear silhouette and restrained lighting, no stars, no ornamental particles. No text, labels, borders, logos or watermarks. This single image is one keyframe, never a contact sheet. Stage:
stages: A distant silhouette low in the central frame, wings folded slightly downward, just entering the first pale shaft of light; ray occupies 30 percent of image width.
The same ray approaches the camera at the center, wings beginning to rise, occupying 45 percent of image width, underside subtly visible.
The same ray at the center now opens both wings broadly, occupying 65 percent of image width, moving toward the brightest shaft.
The same ray passes through the brightest light, both wings lifted elegantly, occupying 75 percent of image width with blue and violet caustic highlights.
The same ray banks gently toward the upper right, one wing tilts downward; occupies 55 percent of image width, tail clearly trailing.
The same ray glides away into the upper right shaft of light, wings outstretched and occupies 30 percent of image width, leaving the center mostly open.
